transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I… I’m a little embarrassed to say it. After I eat too much, I’ve been making myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. It’s happened more than once, and that scared me enough to come in.
How often have you been making yourself vomit after eating too much? Has this been happening regularly, like once a week or more, for several months?
Yeah… it’s been most weeks, for several months now. I’ll have one of those eating spells, usually in secret, and then I make myself sick after. I don’t think I can call it just occasional anymore.
When you eat too much, do you feel like you’ve lost control over your eating, like you can’t stop eating or control what you’re eating?
Yes… during those times, once I start, it’s like I’m on automatic. I keep thinking I should stop before my husband notices, but then I’m still reaching for one more thing.
Has this eating and purging behavior been causing you a lot of distress or affecting your daily life, like your relationships or work?

It has, yes… I mean, I still go to work and church and play bridge. But I find myself planning around food now, or making sure I can get home alone afterward. It makes things that used to be nice feel… tense.
Have you had these episodes of binge eating followed by making yourself vomit at least once a week for the past three months or more?
Yes… for the past several months, it’s been most weeks. I’ll have one of those secret eating spells and then go make myself sick after. So… yes, at least once a week, I suppose.
